quote_keys.quote: the registered verbatim quote of a claim; the build refuses a displayed quote that differs from it, so it is the source's text, never ours
quote_keys.variants: alternate verbatim wordings of a registered quote, accepted only when located in the captured source
quote_keys.text: a quoted rule or statement in the help directory and commitments data, verified against its claim at build time; also search terms in recorded tool calls
quote_keys.snippet: inert snippet text returned by the portal, quoted as evidence
